title: TrustPrisonCore
description: The all-in-one Prison core with rankup, prestige, autosell, multipliers & more.
body:
![top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c348c60bcd9da1d49e4649042012f4688ee35410_0.webp)
![permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8070133312531473ea451d8edd860fb5f8b29f4a.png)

**Mine Management**

/mines create <name> – Create a new mine. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.create[/ICODE])
/mines delete <name> – Delete an existing mine. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.delete[/ICODE])
/mines reset <name> – Instantly reset a mine. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.reset[/ICODE])
/mines addblock <name> – Add blocks and set percentages to a mine. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.addblock[/ICODE])
/mines settings <name> – Configure mine options like auto-reset timer and flight. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.settings[/ICODE])
/mines list – List all created mines. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.list[/ICODE])
/mines wand – Get the selection wand. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.wand[/ICODE])
/mines settep <name> – Set a teleport for mine reset. ([ICODE]trustprison.mines.settp[/ICODE])

**Rank & Prestige**

/rankup – Rank up to the next level. ([ICODE]trustprison.rankup.use[/ICODE])
/rank set <player> <rank> – Set a player's rank. ([ICODE]trustprison.ranks.use[/ICODE])
/prestige – Prestige after reaching final rank. ([ICODE]trustprison.prestige.use[/ICODE])
/prestigerank set <player> <prestige> – Set a player's prestige. ([ICODE]trustprison.prestige.set[/ICODE])
/maxrankup – Rank up through as many ranks as possible. ([ICODE]trustprison.rankup.max[/ICODE])
/prestigemax – Prestige through as many levels as possible. ([ICODE]trustprison.prestige.max[/ICODE])

**Sell & AutoSell Features**

/setprice <price> – Set sell price for the item in hand. ([ICODE]trustprison.autosell.set[/ICODE])
/sellall – Sell all inventory items that have prices. ([ICODE]trustprison.autosell.sell[/ICODE])
/autosell – Toggle automatic selling every X seconds. ([ICODE]trustprison.autosell.toggle[/ICODE])
/money withdraw <amount> - Withdraw money into a paper item

**Multiplier System**

/multiplier setglobal <multiplier> <seconds> – Set a timed global multiplier. ([ICODE]trustprison.multiplier.setglobal[/ICODE])
/multiplier setpersonal <player> <multiplier> <seconds> – Set a timed personal multiplier. ([ICODE]trustprison.multiplier.setpersonal[/ICODE])
/multiplier setpermanent <player> <multiplier> – Set a permanent personal multiplier. ([ICODE]trustprison.multiplier.setpermanent[/ICODE])
/globalmultiplier – View the current global multiplier. ([ICODE]trustprison.multiplier.view[/ICODE])
/multiplierinfo – View your all multipliers (global, personal, permanent).

**Token System**

/tokens give <player> <amount> - Give tokens to a player. ([ICODE]trustprison.tokens.use[/ICODE])
/tokens giveall <amount> - Give tokens to all online players. ([ICODE]trustprison.tokens.use[/ICODE])
/tokens remove <player> <amount> - Remove tokens from a player. ([ICODE]trustprison.tokens.use[/ICODE])
/tokens set <player> <amount> - Set a player's token balance. ([ICODE]trustprison.tokens.use[/ICODE])
/tokens clear <player> - Clear a player’s token balance. ([ICODE]trustprison.tokens.use[/ICODE])
/tokens balance - View your current token balance.
/tokens withdraw <amount> - Withdraw tokens into a paper item

**Backpack System**

/backpack give <player> – Give the player a backpack ([ICODE]trustprison.backpack.give[/ICODE])

**Pouches**

/pouches list – shows all available. ([ICODE]trustprison.pouches.list[/ICODE])
/pouches give <player> <name> – gives the player a pouch. ([ICODE]trustprison.pouches.give[/ICODE])
Pickaxe

/tpc pickaxe give <player> – Gives Custom Pickaxe. ([ICODE]trustprison.pickaxe.give[/ICODE])

**Utilities**

/tpc reload – Reload all plugin configs. ([ICODE]trustprison.reload.use[/ICODE])
/tpc help – View help and command guide. (Multi-page)
/tpc lang list - View all Available Languages
/tpc lang <language> - sets the global language ([ICODE]trustprison.lang.use[/ICODE])
/tpc minedblocks list - view all players mined blocks ([ICODE]trustprison.minedblocks.list[/ICODE])
/tpc minedblocks set <player> <amount> - set a players mined blocks ([ICODE]trustprison.minedblocks.set[/ICODE])
/tpc minedblocks reset <player> - reset a players mined blocks ([ICODE]trustprison.minedblocks.reset[/ICODE])

**Gang Commands**

/gang create <name> → by default character length is 10 characters this can be changed in gangsettings.yml
/gang disband → disband the gang
/gang invite <name> → invite a player to the gang, by default the limit is 5 players, this can be changed in the gangsettings.yml
/gang remove <name> → removes a user from the gang
/gang join <name> → join a gang you have been invited to
/gang leave → leave a gang
/gang info & /gang info [name] → you can view your own gang and manage, and or others.
/gang memebrs → view & manage your own members
/gang chat <message> → sends a message
/gang chat toggle → enable or disable chat
/gang sethome → set the home for the gang
/gang home → teleports to the gang home
/gang deposit → deposit corrupted balance in the gang bank
/gang withdraw → withdraw corrupted balance from the gang bank
/gang bank & /gang bal → you can see the gangs bank
/gang top → see who the top gangs are
/gang value - let's you see the gang's value faster
/cb balance & /cb bal → Check your own corrupted balance

**Gang Permissions**

[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.manage.all → Full gang management (Leader[/ICODE]).
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.manage.promote → Promote gang members[/ICODE].
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.manage.demote → Demote gang members.[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.manage.kick → Kick players from the gang.[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.manage.withdraw → Withdraw gang funds.[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.gang.manage.upgrades → Manage gang upgrades.[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.gang.manage.invite → Invite new players to the gang.[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.gang.manage.sethome → Set the home for the gang.[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.border.bypass → Bypass Gang Island Border[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprison.gangs.gang.upgrades → Allowed to purchase gang upgrades[/ICODE]
[ICODE]trustprisoncore.gangisland.blocks → Allows users to break and place blocks in any island[/ICODE]

**Placeholders**

%tpc_prestige_prefix% → Shows Rank Prefix
%tpc_prestige% → Shows the player’s current prestige name
%tpc_prestige_progress_percent% → Percentage to next prestige
%tpc_prestige_progress_bar% → Progress bar to next prestige
%tpc_next_prestige% → Displays the next prestige name
%tpc_rank% → Shows the player’s current rank name
%tpc_rank_prefix% → Shows the prefix of the player’s current rank
%tpc_rank_progress_percent% → Percentage to next rank
%tpc_rank_progress_bar% → Progress bar to next rank
%tpc_next_rank% → Displays the next rank name
%tpc_tokens% → Shows the player’s token balance
%tpc_gang_name% → shows the gang you are in
%corruptedbalance% → shows balance of corrupted balance
%gang_bank% → shows the gangs bank balance
%gang_members% → shows how many members are in the gang
%gang_leader% → shows the gang leaders name




![dependencies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad0b8a2bc4acb4b98c9a217bd6f5c37dddaedde1.png)
Dependencies - **Vault, Worldedit, WorldGuard, FAWE, Essentials and Luckperms**
This plugin has a custom built in chat format, you don't need a chat plugin, any chat plugin will override this plugins chat and Ranks & Prestiges Placeholders will not work.
During the development progress more placeholders will be supported and added to the chat for it to support other plugins
